nodes.label: date-fns v2.30.0 / @date-io/date-fns 2.17.0
nodes.rationale: FireCMS v2 requires date-fns v2 specifically; v3 completely removes the longFormatters file, causing SSR crashes.

nodes.label: Master Installation Command
nodes.rationale: A single pinned dependency command for the tech lead that bypasses all React 19 / MUI version clashes.

nodes.norm_label: material ui v5 (@mui/material, icons, lab, x-date-pickers)
nodes.rationale: Pinned to v5 because FireCMS v2 requires Material UI v5.

nodes.label: Accent Colors (Action Red #E31837, Venture Cyan #27A9E1, Energy Yellow #FFD100)
nodes.norm_label: accent colors (action red #e31837, venture cyan #27a9e1, energy yellow #ffd100)
nodes.rationale: Red for primary call-to-action buttons; cyan for hover states, links and interactive elements; yellow sparingly for small badges or highlighted text.

nodes.label: Dark Color Palette (Charcoal #0A0A0A / #171717, Off-white #FAFAFA, Gray #A1A1AA)
nodes.rationale: Deep charcoal background lessens contrast and prevents eye fatigue in dark mode; lighter charcoal surface creates elevation and depth for cards and grids; off-white text for optimal readability.

nodes.label: Quiet Luxury Aesthetic (Minimalist Icons)
nodes.rationale: Minimalist icons for ventures and menu items are chosen to align with the Quiet Luxury aesthetic.

nodes.label: Responsive Single-Column Mobile Layout
nodes.rationale: All sections collapse into a single column on mobile devices for optimal viewing.

nodes.label: --legacy-peer-deps Flag
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 uses React 19, which conflicts with MUI v5; the flag bypasses the peer dependency conflict.
